# Support

Thank you for using FinBank API. This document explains where to get help, ask questions, and report issues.

---

## 🐛 Bug Reports

Found a bug? Please [open a Bug Report](https://github.com/Mostafa-SAID7/Bank-Api/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) using the issue template.

Include:
- Steps to reproduce
- Expected vs. actual behavior
- Your environment (.NET version, OS, PostgreSQL version)

> ⚠️ **Security vulnerabilities must NOT be reported via public issues.** See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for private disclosure.

---

## 💡 Feature Requests

Have an idea? [Open a Feature Request](https://github.com/Mostafa-SAID7/Bank-Api/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).

---

## ❓ Questions & General Help

### GitHub Discussions

The best place for questions, ideas, and community help:
👉 [github.com/Mostafa-SAID7/Bank-Api/discussions](https://github.com/Mostafa-SAID7/Bank-Api/discussions)

Use the following categories:
- **Q&A** — technical questions about setup, configuration, or usage
- **Ideas** — feature suggestions and design discussions
- **Show & Tell** — share what you built with the API

### Documentation

Before asking, check the docs — your answer may already be there:

| Topic | Link |
|---|---|
| Project setup | [docs/PROJECT_SETUP.md](../docs/PROJECT_SETUP.md) |
| Architecture | [docs/STRUCTURE.md](../docs/STRUCTURE.md) |
| Deployment | [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) |
| API features | [docs/FEATURES.md](../docs/FEATURES.md) |
| Technologies | [docs/TECHNOLOGIES.md](../docs/TECHNOLOGIES.md) |
| Swagger UI | `http://localhost:5000/swagger` (when running locally) |

## 🔐 Security Issues

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report privately via email: **security@bankproject.com**

Full details in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
